x: "Steve" Gibson, Les Christmas and Stan Botwright will be our main hopes in the Long Jump, but it would be good to see Geoff Wood taking part in this event more often as it is felt he has good possibilities. Geoff Wood and Les Christmas, together with Bert Machell, will be our Hop, Step and Jump men.
Conditions were not improved when mid-way through the season we lost the services of Steve Gibson, one of our most promising high jumpers who went into hospital for an operation on an old war wound.

Now that Pete Lowe has recovered from his injury we look forward to having him in both these events. Steve Gibson can do really good performances in the Long Jump and Geoff. Barker in both events should make us stronger than for some years.

Steve Gibson will be available again, together with Nick Nickini, who showed promise before going into the Forces. In the Long Jump and Hop, Step and Jump it looks as if we shall have some better performances than since 1939.
